measure.measure_definition: Measured value: NT-proBNP concentration in serum or plasma; Participants; NT-proBNP measured in serum or plasma at baseline (randomization visit), Week 4, Week 8, Week 12 and Week 16; central laboratory after randomization; summarized by arm as geometric mean with 95% CI.; NT-proBNP concentration reported in ng l−1; baseline defined as the randomization visit. Values are labeled geometric mean here because the article text and Fig. 2 describe geometric means; Table 2 header labels the summary as median, a conflict noted below.

Measured value: plasma cGMP concentration; Participants; Plasma cGMP measured at baseline, Week 8 and Week 16; summarized by arm as geometric mean with 95% CI.; Plasma cGMP concentration reported in nMol l−1; baseline and Week 16 values used. Values are labeled geometric mean here because the article text and Fig. 2 describe geometric means; Table 2 header labels the summary as median, a conflict noted below.
Investigator-reported occurrence of worsening heart failure in Table 3, counted as patients with an event; separate from all-cause death/worsening-HF composite and from number of recurrent episodes.

population.intervention: XXB750 (fully human monoclonal IgG1 antibody targeting NPR1).
population.intervention_regimen: 60 mg on Day 1, then 120 mg at Weeks 4, 8 and 12 (120 mg target dose).; Subcutaneous injection every 4 weeks; four injections over the 16-week treatment period (Day 1, Week 4, Week 8, Week 12).
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment arm (XXB750 120 mg) within the background ACEi/ARB stratum.; Adults with symptomatic heart failure (NYHA class II–III), LVEF <50%, elevated NT-proBNP, and stable background ACE inhibitor or ARB therapy (not background sacubitril/valsartan) at baseline; randomized to XXB750 120 mg target dose. Group size is the n reported for the background ACE/ARB column in Table 3.
population.population_name: ACEi/ARB background stratum — XXB750 120 mg (reported group)
population.population_time_frame: Randomization period 27 December 2023 to 8 August 2024; biomarker samples at baseline and Week 16; safety observation through 12 weeks after last dose.
